questions.question: Is this a real bank?
questions.answer: Right now it is a large pet-project and product concept. Banking integrations, KYC and real payments can be connected later.

questions.question: What will be inside the ecosystem?
questions.answer: Banking and cards, transfers, subscriptions, travel, hotels, marketplace, partner rewards and later business tools.

questions.question: Will there be a mobile app?
questions.answer: The web app already includes accounts, cards, operations, payments and security settings. A mobile client can extend the same journeys separately.

questions.question: Why a dark interface?
questions.answer: The dark system is closer to a banking dashboard, keeps accents readable and works well for future cards, transactions and analytics screens.

questions.question: What comes next?
questions.answer: The next stage is stronger architecture, accessibility, failure handling and preparation for real banking integrations.

TeamAbout.text:
Pulse is a fintech ecosystem concept where the bank does not end with a card and transfers.

Payments, travel, hotels, marketplace, subscriptions, personal offers and spending analytics are combined into one product layer. The user sees a clear system around daily decisions instead of scattered sections.

The demo already includes personal banking, business accounts, investing, insurance, travel, mobile and marketplace journeys. The next layer is real integrations, identity and payment infrastructure.

Values.courage-text: Users should see fees, rates and conditions before an action.
Values.perseverance-text: Payments, transfers and services should work without extra steps.
Values.reliability-text: Money, data and transactions need calm and understandable protection.
Values.responsibility-text: Every ecosystem service should solve a real user scenario.
Values.bravery-text: Device, limit and confirmation controls are always close.
Values.persistence-text: Banking, travel, marketplace and business services work as one product.
